string.name: app_mode_tcp_desc
string.value: Auto discovery, low bandwidth and latency

string.name: app_tip_usb
string.value: Requires SysDVR in USB mode, in handheld mode (not docked). Connect with an OTG adapter (USB-C male → USB-A female on this device) plus a USB-A to USB-C cable. With a C-to-C cable the phone becomes the USB device and cannot see the console.

string.name: app_tip_rtsp
string.value: RTSP is broadly compatible, but has no NAL replay and uses more bandwidth; smoothing and background keep-alive are unavailable. If it won't connect, tap “Test connection” or restart the game.

string.name: app_tip_tcp
string.value: Recommended: turn on the device hotspot in Settings so the console connects directly to your phone (5 GHz). Keep WLAN on, but don't join another Wi-Fi network.
